dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent linear narrowing of the 2D profile from the mid-body toward the posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight symmetrical protrusions at the anterior-lateral margins followed by a smooth concave transition toward the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear features present on the mid-dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct, dark longitudinal line along the central posterior axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint linear marks on the upper dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior-most dorsal point.
